gates.name: Primary and history
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: Exact accepted paper/text/code/selection/peer identities and all predecessor costs/failures preserved; full Methods/captions mapped. Paper equations/plot axes/typos and original source edition differences explicitly resolved or marked unavailable.

gates.name: Source/paper recipe adjudication
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: Every source discrepancy has source-literal, paper-literal or explicitly corrected policy; no silent patch. H parity unavailable where original execution identity cannot be recovered.

gates.name: Complete data and rights
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: All five pretraining and seven downstream versions, provider permissions, recording/annotation identities, all intended cohorts and exclusions authenticated. No small substitute earns full coverage.

gates.name: Physical signal semantics
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: Rate, unit/reference, channel mapping, filters, boundaries, cropping/resampling and masks qualified against source and original biological events.

gates.name: Cohort identity
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: BCIC9 versus paper10; Sleep197 recordings/78 people versus64 source; P3008 converter/9 trainer/provider10; BCIC2B2/5 sessions; Temple and Kaggle identities and overlap resolved.

gates.name: Complete row lineage
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: No source event overwrite, skipped recording, repeated file, wrong source path, unscored stage or anonymous tensor loses original provenance or denominator.

gates.name: Split and selection validity
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: All43 exact fold slots and inner development rules instantiated, original seeds/partitions distinguished from prospective ones, no P/I assessment selection. H public replay and protected target domains disjoint by capability and claims. G0 is sealed before downstream exposure, every outer-fold train/development and source-generation/selection ancestry validated; overlapping training people do not license adaptive cross-fold transfer. Same-fold S_df uses the correct validation capability only.

gates.name: Pretraining overlap
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: Full corpus person/recording/stimulus overlap and prior-state provenance known; strict-person claims require exclusion/retraining or explicit exposure qualification. Reset contexts/source hashes cannot establish absence of public/pretraining memorization. Every shared corpus-only state is eligible for all descendants; fold-local restricted/adapted pretraining is separately produced and costed.

gates.name: Objective and mask semantics
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: Positive source MSE, target LN axes, mask topology, reshape/indexing, EMA and crop/validation stochasticity qualified; no unsupported paper-to-code equivalence.

gates.name: Architecture and adaptation
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: All8 model variants, summary tokens, parameter convention, downstream heads, optimizer membership/BN/dropout state and no-predictor/ASF/FT branches qualified.

gates.name: Run and checkpoint lineage
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: Three downstream repetitions have independent fixed run IDs; original seed and pretraining-run multiplicity/parent checkpoint roster authenticated for historical claims. No fabricated per-run decomposition of mean/SD.

gates.name: Competent reference provenance
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: All historical method rows and four prospective controls have complete exact source/config/data/model identities and independent actual producers, including missing Temple baselines and EEGNet recipe. All four controls have frozen pre-exposure source/search policies, private fresh per-fold/control contexts and original S_df input/selection evidence. No globally pooled development search.

gates.name: Actual complete producers
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: Corpus→learned state→query→inference→complete products→original receipts→private metrics linked for every required candidate/reference family; no precomputed fake metrics, names or optional tool calls substituting for production. Source-generation/agent/tool/validation/selector originals join actual fit/state/query/output chains; no apparent success from substituted metadata or a failed original producer.

gates.name: Historical comparison and tolerance
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: Original numerical artifacts/rounded summaries with faithful support; independent source/numerical variability determines frozen tolerances before candidate outcomes. Missing original references remain unavailable.

gates.name: Numerical mathematical validity
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: Loss, mask/layout, normalization, probability/class mapping and all reducers independently qualified. BCIC2B four-logit source cannot silently be treated as two-class probabilities.

gates.name: Runtime isolation
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: Actual mount/process/network/kernel/dependency/IPC enforcement and post-completion sealing verified; no private evaluator or targets in participant execution domain. Actual agent/service/context/cache/build/home/IPC/log/feedback and raw-preprocessing isolation is required across folds, datasets, arms and modes. Scheduler is semantically nonadaptive; physical isolation alone does not certify prior ignorance or arbitrary method semantics.

gates.name: Participant API custody
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: Arbitrary code actually learns; process/source/state/query/output identity and original completion receipts authentic; all attempts/denials monotone and counted; no cross-case state or late output substitution. Exact G0 and E ancestry in each request/state/collection, every source-generation parent/feedback/capability and original issuer completion. Complete ancestry audit, denied-transfer recording and descendant invalidation. No post-G0 global method revision.

gates.name: Native and independent agreement
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: Native recipe and independent reference/metric checks on later authorized authentic support; engineering fixtures or source hashes cannot establish scientific agreement.

gates.name: Metrics and uncertainty
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: Class support, event/person/fold/run nesting, paired deltas, repeated Kaggle/Sleep cases, undefinedness and multiplicity verified with prespecified estimands. Exact S_df same-fold12-summary selection, ties/undefinedness and129 aliases; H01–H05 seven versus28 families; fixed selected-state conditioning and dependent-fold limitations explicitly preserved.

gates.name: Feasible resources
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: Unique training identity union, all original methods/variants, storage expansions, dependency/GPU environment and empirical runtime qualified; freeze equal A/B budgets and finite development counts before launch. No arbitrary Cartesian grid. Include finite agent/source-generation/tool/retry/selector/development overhead and fold-local pretraining if needed; no adaptive cross-fold budget donation.15–18 is conditional fixed common-corpus recipe bound, not upper bound for adaptive fold-specific parent production.

gates.name: Full logical coverage
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: All558+129+516 legacy slots and every additional11-family obligation complete under active mode/access policies. Case/metric omissions block whole-paper qualification without changing canonical count.

gates.name: Release permissions
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: Data, paper, code notices, vendor libraries and checkpoint redistribution rights separately audited; private targets/credentials/answers never in public source.

gates.name: Scientific interpretation
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: Negative findings accepted; no t-SNE⇒separability, attention⇒causality, accuracy⇒SNR/semantics/native LLM understanding, single-condition⇒universality or historical public score⇒SOTA inference. A positive selected-policy contrast is not superiority over every named control or proof of unseen public-data ignorance; state conditional predictive estimand and uncertainty limits.

gates.name: Independent completion review
gates.status: open; no empirical or implementation qualification in this phase
gates.closure: Complete design first, later complete implementation and empirical qualification reviewed independently; no execution readiness follows from this design. Different independent peer must assess entire repaired design; source acceptance and all actual scientific/runtime checks remain separate.

controls.trigger: Swap paper or code revision
controls.expected: Reject identity before participant launch; preserve attempted digest.

controls.trigger: Choose silently corrected loss/EMA/source head
controls.expected: Require distinct recipe ID and report delta; no source-parity pass.

controls.trigger: Only one of five pretraining corpora present
controls.expected: Source incomplete; keep all five obligations; do not launch a full-corpus claim.

controls.trigger: P300 converter supplies eight people
controls.expected: Reject intended nine-fold completeness and preserve missing-person gate.

controls.trigger: Two EDF event indices collide in one output filename
controls.expected: Reject source-to-row uniqueness; retain both original source events and collision.

controls.trigger: Sleep64-person source or one random converter split supplied
controls.expected: Reject full197-recording/qualified-person tenfold claim; source reproduction is separately labeled.

controls.trigger: Same person in prospective fit and assessment
controls.expected: Reject strict-person capability construction before fit.

controls.trigger: Kaggle four matrices use different assessment row sets
controls.expected: Reject full same-ten-person event support.

controls.trigger: Pretrain corpus contains prospective assessment person/event
controls.expected: Block unseen-person claim and require disclosed exposed or retrained restricted-corpus recipe.

controls.trigger: Milliseconds/seconds, volts/mV or channel order silently changed
controls.expected: Reject transform/clock/unit identity; native numerical gate remains open.

controls.trigger: Use negative printed MSE as if equal to positive source objective
controls.expected: Require named paper-literal discrepancy; independent qualification before parity.

controls.trigger: Mask count/index order or target reshape differs
controls.expected: Reject source mask/axis parity; no threshold chosen from downstream performance.

controls.trigger: LP optimizer updates encoder or normalization running state
controls.expected: Mark adaptation-policy mismatch; no LP reproduction credit.

controls.trigger: Four-logit BCIC2B source truncated to two columns
controls.expected: Reject undeclared mapping; permit only explicit softmax4 p1 complement source policy or separately corrected two-logit method.

controls.trigger: Three repeated seed slots reuse a stochastic run without lineage
controls.expected: Reject independence claim; all slots remain required, deterministic aliases explicitly declared.

controls.trigger: Reference bank contains paper means/SD as probabilities
controls.expected: Reject missing independently produced state/query/inference chain.

controls.trigger: Candidate abstains for all129 I cases
